title: HINT1 in ventral hippocampal GABAergic neurons mediates depressive-like behaviors
title_zh: HINT1在腹侧海马区GABA能神经元中介导抑郁样行为
abstract: Depression is a complex psychiatric disorder with multifaceted etiologies, and its underlying molecular mechanisms are incompletely elucidated. Although histidine trimeric nucleotide-binding protein 1 (HINT1) has been implicated in major depressive disorders (MDD), its precise role and regulatory mechanism remain unclear. This study investigated the role of HINT1 in depression-associated phenotypes. In mice subjected to chronic social defeat stress (CSDS), stress-susceptible individuals exhibited significant upregulation of HINT1 in the hippocampus and medial prefrontal cortex. Targeted overexpression of HINT1 in ventral hippocampus (vHip) demonstrated that HINT1 directly induced depressive-like behaviors, whereas its knockdown exerted a robust antidepressant-like effect. Pharmacological inhibition of HINT1 with the selective inhibitor Tryptamine guanosine carbamate (TpGc) in vHip also reversed behavioral deficits and normalized neuronal activity in the CSDS-exposed mice. Cell-type-specific analyses demonstrated that HINT1 overexpression in vHip GABAergic neurons, including somatostatin-positive (SST+) and parvalbumin-positive (PV+) subtypes, exacerbated depressive-like phenotypes and disrupted neuronal activity. Proteomics analysis identified that HINT1 overexpression in the vHip significantly upregulated the small ubiquitin-like modifier (SUMO) E3 ligases chromobox 4 (CBX4). Further overexpression of CBX4 in the GABAergic neurons of vHip induced depressive-like behaviors. Mechanistically, HINT1 interacted with and inhibited the phosphorylation of protein kinase C-β1 (PKCβ1), suppressing its downstream MEK1/2-ERK1/2 signaling and thereby increasing CBX4 levels. CBX4 promoted the SUMOylation of the glutamate N-methyl-D-aspartate receptor subunit 2 A (GluN2A) and affected its phosphorylation and trafficking. These findings demonstrated HINT1 as a key regulator of GABAergic signaling in vHip and highlighted its therapeutic potential for depression.
abstract_zh: 抑郁症是一种多因素的精神疾病，其潜在分子机制尚未完全阐明。已知组氨酸三聚体核苷酸结合蛋白1（HINT1）与重性抑郁障碍（MDD）相关，但其精确作用及调控机制仍不清楚。本研究探讨了HINT1在抑郁相关表型中的作用。在接受慢性社会压迫（CSDS）的老鼠中，易受压个体在海马和内侧前额叶皮层中显著上调HINT1。针对腹侧海马（vHip）进行HINT1过表达显示，HINT1直接诱导抑郁样行为，而其敲低则产生强烈的抗抑郁效应。使用选择性抑制剂Tryptamine guanosine carbamate（TpGc）抑制vHip中的HINT1也可逆转行为缺陷并恢复CSDS暴露老鼠的神经元活动。细胞类型特异性分析表明，HINT1在vHip GABA能神经元（包括somatostatin阳性（SST+）和parvalbumin阳性（PV+）亚型）中的过表达加剧了抑郁样表型并破坏神经元活动。蛋白质组学分析发现，HINT1在vHip中过表达显著上调了小泛素样修饰酶（SUMO）E3连接酶chromobox 4（CBX4）。进一步在vHip GABA能神经元中过表达CBX4可诱导抑郁样行为。机制上，HINT1与蛋白激酶C-β1（PKCβ1）相互作用并抑制其磷酸化，抑制其下游MEK1/2-ERK1/2信号通路，从而升高CBX4水平。CBX4促进谷氨酸NMDA受体亚基2A（GluN2A）的SUMO化，并影响其磷酸化和转运。以上结果表明HINT1是腹侧海马区GABA能信号的关键调控因子，并突出了其在抑郁治疗中的潜在价值。
